name: Tajuu Ryoujoku
source:
Main character falls in love with a beautiful woman who is worried about her dreams at a party. He keeps  thinking about this woman. One day intercom rings and that woman enters his place. She says she wants to be with him. They start to live together, but there is one secret about her...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一次聚会上爱上了一位为自己的梦想而烦恼的美丽女子。他心里一直想着这个女人。有一天，对讲机响了，那个女人走进了他的位置。她说她想和他在一起。他们开始同居，但她却有一个秘密……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
